name: Claim one submission to admit
description:
THE ADMISSION QUEUE, and the match claim's shape: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with LIMIT 1, so two admitting runners never queue behind each other, and a lease minted here that nothing renews -- an admission is seconds of work, so a lease that lapses is a runner that vanished and the next claim takes the row. Every claim spends an attempt (admissions.attempts), which is what lets a submission that kills every runner that touches it run out of them and expire; the claim never takes one that has none left, so the expiry and a claim cannot race.

WHAT THE RUNNER IS GIVEN, and nothing else: the registration the admit clock rebuilt from the manifest at the centre -- never the competitor's document, so a `reference` has nowhere to survive -- the artifact's key and the digest the node re-hashes it against, the adapter budget, the deadline for each inference, and the first admit_observations of the game's reference observations, read straight from `games` so no clock message ever carries the set.

A CLAIM STATES WHAT IT RUNS: the stats a verdict is judged on are the Orion's that measured them, so a runner on another Orion than this node's orion_version is refused with 409 rather than left to claim -- recorded against one version and measured by another is exactly what a re-validation sweep looks for. An empty queue is 200 {"idle": true}, as the match claim's is.

with.name: A claim states what it runs
with.description: The Orion that will register, admit and probe the model is the one whose stats the verdict is judged on.

with.name: Another Orion measures differently
with.description: A 409 on every poll rather than an idle answer, because a misconfigured admitting runner that quietly claimed nothing would look exactly like an empty queue.

input.query: WITH pick AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT a.version_id FROM admissions a JOIN model_versions v ON v.id = a.version_id AND v.status = 'testing' WHERE a.report IS NULL AND (a.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR a.lease_expires_at < now()) AND a.attempts < ($4)::int AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_runners lr WHERE lr.id = ($1)::uuid) ORDER BY a.prepared_at, a.version_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF a SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE admissions a SET runner_id = ($1)::uuid, claim_token = ($2)::uuid, lease_expires_at = now() + ($3)::int * interval '1 second', attempts = a.attempts + 1 FROM pick WHERE a.version_id = pick.version_id

SELECT json_build_object( 'admission', json_build_object( 'version_id', a.version_id, 'model', ($2)::text || a.version_id::text, 'registration', a.registration, 'artifact', json_build_object('key', v.artifact_key, 'digest', v.weights_hash), 'budget_ops', a.budget_ops, 'infer_ms', ($4)::int, 'attempt', a.attempts, 'observations', CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(g.reference_observations) = 'array' THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(o.obs ORDER BY o.n), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(g.reference_observations) WITH ORDINALITY AS o (obs, n) WHERE o.n <= ($3)::int) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END), 'lease_expires_at', a.lease_expires_at) AS body FROM admissions a JOIN model_versions v ON v.id = a.version_id JOIN games g ON g.id = v.game_id WHERE a.claim_token = ($1)::uuid
